title: cymbalaria microcalyx
intro: Cymbalaria microcalyx, commonly known as Alpine Mouse Ear, is a species of flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Cymbalaria microcalyx include its ability to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation, as well as its potential to exhibit antimicrobial and antidiabetic activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
